[.walkthrough]
.Change a button's caption
. Switch to *Edit* mode in the toolbar.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/edit-text/01-edit-mode.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/edit-text/01-edit-mode.jpg"]
. Copilot's [.walkthrough-look]#Editing# tab names the file you are editing, here [filename]#ContactView.java#. You can change the components that this file creates. The rest of the page, such as the main layout, is dimmed.
+
image::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/edit-text/02-context.jpg["Copilot's Editing tab names the file you are editing, here ContactView.java. You can change the components that this file creates. The rest of the page, such as the main layout, is dimmed."]
. Double-click the text, type the new one and press kbd:[Enter]. Copilot changes the string in your Java code, and the view updates.
+
video::{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/edit-text/03-double-click.mp4[options="autoplay,loop,muted",poster="{articles}/vaadin/videos/copilot/edit-text/03-double-click.jpg"]
